turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You asked for this meeting. Who decided on Owen's zero?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No. Who decided on the zero?
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Hard for you. Owen found out from his phone, in the middle of a class. What do you have?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.

Aren't perfect. The company that sells that checker prints in its own guide that it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have that page in my bag. So is ninety-four percent all you have?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58. What date, and why am I hearing about this a week after the zero went in? Turn the screen.
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Stop that. You were about to show me the screen.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not here to grade you, Hale. The date on that file, on the screen, now.
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
Editions differ, and students paraphrase. Show me where that line sits in Owen's essay. And I'm still waiting on that date.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Outlines change; that's what they're for. That's three things you've described and none you've put in front of me. Paper, or the screen.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? Owen's essay.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
A rewrite for what, on evidence you still haven't shown me? And nothing on his record goes in writing, whatever happens. Ten minutes.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
You want me to do your job for you too? Show me the screen, or I'm going to the principal.
